review_rationale: Reviewed both complete independent source formulations, exact live effective occurrence identities, target formulations and all unrelated effective references. The Ext source permits associative unital R and requires an R-linear-map component without an unsupported commutative-R internal Hom module structure. The locally connected source uses pointwise potentially nonopen connected neighborhood systems, not the global open-family datum, whose valid equivalent characterization remains documented separately. Preserve source text, other references, correct missing candidates, full provenance and the unopened consolidation gate.

changes.reason: The current existing target defines Hom_R as an R-module via scalar action only when R is commutative, but the Ext source does not assume commutativity. For associative unital R, Hom_R(F_i,N) consists of R-linear maps and forms an abelian group under pointwise addition, without a canonical left R-module scalar action. The existing general module-linear meaning correctly supplies only the element-level prerequisite, not the entire Hom group. Retain the distinct missing cochain-complex candidate and all other dependencies.

updates.context: Underlying component prerequisite only: R-linear homomorphisms of left modules over an associative unital ring R. The Hom_R(F_i,N) collection is an abelian group by pointwise addition; no commutative-R internal-Hom R-module structure is asserted.

changes.reason: The source's fundamental system at each point is a cofinal system of connected neighborhoods, whose members need not be open. The stored global topology-basis meaning instead requires a family of open subsets covering all points. A locally connected space does admit a derived connected-open global basis, by connected components of open sets being open, but the individual pointwise neighborhood-system occurrence is not that global datum. Preserve the exact independent missing local connected-neighborhood-system candidate and the separate source links.

updates.disposition: The specific pointwise neighborhood system is already represented by the separate missing candidate missing.eb8e1a62d06acf7c487c.
